name: Two-Handed Fighter
summary: A heavy-weapon specialist who trades bravery, armor training, and armor mastery for overwhelming Strength and maneuver damage.

features.name: Shattering Strike +1
features.summary: Gain +1 to CMB and CMD on sunder attempts and damage rolls against objects.

features.name: Shattering Strike +2
features.summary: Gain +2 to CMB and CMD on sunder attempts and damage rolls against objects.

features.name: Shattering Strike +3
features.summary: Gain +3 to CMB and CMD on sunder attempts and damage rolls against objects.

features.name: Shattering Strike +4
features.summary: Gain +4 to CMB and CMD on sunder attempts and damage rolls against objects.

features.name: Shattering Strike +5
features.summary: Gain +5 to CMB and CMD on sunder attempts and damage rolls against objects.

features.name: Overhand Chop
features.summary: On a single attack or charge with a two-handed weapon, add double your Strength bonus to damage.

features.name: Backswing
features.summary: During a full attack with a two-handed weapon, add double your Strength bonus to damage on every attack after the first.

features.name: Piledriver
features.summary: As a standard action, make one two-handed melee attack; on a hit, make a free bull rush or trip that does not provoke.

features.name: Greater Power Attack
features.summary: Power Attack's bonus damage with a two-handed melee weapon is doubled instead of increased by half.

features.name: Devastating Blow
features.summary: As a standard action, make one two-handed melee attack at -5; a hit is treated as a critical threat.

featureOverrides.summary: Gain +1 on attack and damage rolls with two-handed melee weapons.
Increase the attack and damage bonus with two-handed melee weapons to +2.
Increase the attack and damage bonus with two-handed melee weapons to +3.
Increase the attack and damage bonus with two-handed melee weapons to +4.
